sections.Profile:
The "Fiesta" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation on December 9, 1959, is a two-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1959
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Hispanic, Two player, Party, Wood Rail, Original Theme, Festival, Music, Single level playfield
